entries.5d91298d51c21757: Its foundation is a structure that focuses on the health, medical and nursing care fields and handles development, sales, implementation and maintenance in-house in an integrated manner. Since its founding in 1969, the company has continued to develop medical information systems. In addition to its flagship products, the current versions of the ordering system NEWTONS2 and the electronic medical record system Shinpan e-Karte®, its product lineup includes department systems and regional collaboration systems.

entries.8a708778a195c59c: The company's management philosophy is “Contributing to society through the creation of systems that make the most of people,” and its basic policies are “Specialization,” “Value Creation,” and “Independence.” The company's management strategy rests on three pillars: realizing medical DX, securing and expanding recurring revenue through a growing maintenance service business, and achieving sustainable growth by strengthening earnings capability. It aims to establish a firm position in the growing medical information systems market and to improve corporate value.

entries.92c87a8d751452d9: This is the single-segment business conducted by the group consisting of the company and two subsidiaries. It develops and sells medical information systems, including ordering systems and electronic medical record systems, through to their implementation, and also provides maintenance services to users of these systems and sells hardware such as servers required for implementation. The consolidated subsidiary is SS-Net Co., Ltd., which plans, designs, installs, constructs, operates and maintains information equipment, among other activities. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥42,298 million.

entries.f376872a51e5f3e7: It operates as a single segment, the Medical Information Systems Business, and by product and service, hardware at ¥19,129 million is the largest, followed by software at ¥11,845 million and maintenance services at ¥10,083 million. Medical information systems, including electronic medical records, are expected to continue to spread, and with replacement demand for existing systems added, competition in the medical information systems market is said to be intensifying further.
entries.f429b3757274251e: As of October 2025, the number of facilities that had introduced medical information systems reached 1,000, and maintenance service revenue was ¥10,083 million (up 9.9% year on year). The fiscal year is positioned as one in which the expansion of the user base and the strengthening of recurring revenue, which the company has set out as goals, also appeared in its results.
